Https://youtu.be/XOHdvjVkBdE Om jay jagdish hare | Om Jai Jagdish Hare Aarti | Mahendra Kapoor | Ekadashi Special
Bhagvan shri hari vishnu ki divy aarti **Om jay jagdish hare** mahendr kapur ke madhur svaron men shravan kijie aur prabhu ki bhakti men lin ho jaeee.
Ekadshi ke pavan avsar par bhagvan vishnu ki aaradhna, bhajan aur aarti ka vishesh mahatv hai. is shubh din shri hari ki aarti karke unka aashirvad prapt karen aur apne jivan men sukh, shanti evan samriddhi ki kamna karen.
